answer: Charge each identity the marginal cost of reproducing its work. Keep a kernel of verified state per account and hold its credit as an ember that cools unless fresh work renews it every epoch. Match every submission against the ledger by replay, so a copied answer resolves to the original signer. A farm of N copies pays N times the compute, N times the renewal, and is caught on the first replay. A pearl grows one layer per epoch; a thousand layers cost a thousand epochs of real work.
